title: Register Trace Explainer
description: Build a small tool that steps through a RISC-V program and explains, in plain English, what each instruction did to the registers.
first_task: Parse a 3-instruction program and print the before/after value of each register touched.
definition_of_done: Given any short RV32I snippet, your tool prints a correct step-by-step register trace.

title: C-to-RISC-V Explorer
description: Explore how small C functions compile down to RISC-V assembly using Compiler Explorer / a local toolchain, and document the patterns you find.
first_task: Compile a simple `add` function to RISC-V assembly and annotate each generated instruction.
definition_of_done: A short writeup mapping 3 C constructs (loop, conditional, function call) to their RISC-V equivalents.

title: Instruction Decoder Visualizer
description: Build a visualizer that takes a raw RISC-V instruction encoding and breaks it into its opcode/funct3/funct7/register fields.
first_task: Decode a single R-type instruction (e.g. `add`) into its bit fields and label each one.
definition_of_done: Your tool correctly decodes at least R-type, I-type, and B-type instructions.
